# MemristiveCrossbarArray

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A dense grid of memristive devices used to perform analog matrix-vector multiplications, directly mapping synaptic weights to physical conductance states. Serves as the core computational substrate for both TCC and iNEST, enabling high-throughput, low-energy neural computations within network nodes.
